cautions: This is a fitted-content dose intervention at a common full prefix, not an end-to-end process in which old sources were trained for only 1024 steps.
The dose contrast does not assert equal old/new candidate quality.
Bootstrap intervals are descriptive and do not establish adequate statistical power.
Selector outcomes are evaluated on future branches; future outcomes do not enter selector decisions.

codec_probability_drift.definition: Distributions use physical post-action branch records only; dose aliases are excluded from counts.

config.scope: One common prefix per case. Observer captures old source after 1024 environment steps, full source after 2048, new sources after 1024. Only old retained candidate content changes. No unknown-context claim or new deployable selector.
config.seed_selection: first two seeds in each (old family A/B, reward-conflict old sign +/-) stratum scanning 21301..21400; mapping only, no rollout outcomes inspected

costs_and_integrity.alias_rule: alias rewards use logical branch reward and H; actual envsteps must be exactly zero; aliases are not independent observations

protocol_estimators.aliases: logical reward retained, measured actual envsteps reported as zero, never resampled as independent units
protocol_estimators.candidate_scope: old_source_1024 is installed only at the decision fork; the common prefix still uses 2048 steps per old source
protocol_estimators.history_weighting: equal weight over configured histories ['old_major', 'new_major'] within each seed before seed-cluster bootstrap
protocol_estimators.reward: cumulative future reward / logical future environment steps
